ModMetaData.description:
SexSlaveCraft 2.3.5 (TieJin Modify) 新增自我调教：独立许可、右键手动指派与自动分流，使用独立评分、完成记忆和许可状态心情。 新角色及旧档缺字段时默认开启；四阶段分流概率为 30%／55%／80%／50%，首版仍受禁止自慰基因阻断。 修复调教站位同步打断任务及旧回调干扰新工作；补齐繁中、俄文限制面板文本与任务生命周期回归。 基于上游 2.2.8 继续维护，包含完整战斗员特化等 2.3.4 及更早版本内容。 锁链达到第 2 阶段的 SSC 性奴可按 RJW 原有条件被指派为泄欲对象；见习性奴不因此获得资格。 旧 RimTalk 兼容继续暂停，宠物猫、宠物兔未完成入口继续禁用。 完整中英双语更新记录见 CHANGELOG.md。
Version 2.3.5 adds self-training with separate permission, manual orders, automatic diversion, scoring, completion memories and permission-state moods. Enabled by default for new pawns and old saves missing the field. Stage chances are 30% / 55% / 80% / 50%; anti-masturbation genes still block it. Fixes Training interrupted by position synchronization and stale callbacks interfering with replacement jobs; completes Traditional Chinese and Russian restriction text and task lifecycle regression coverage. Continues development from upstream 2.2.8, including the complete Combatant specialization and other 2.3.4 and earlier content. SSC sex slaves at Chain stage 2 or higher can be designated as RJW Comfort pawns under RJW's existing conditions; trainees gain no eligibility from SSC identity alone. Legacy RimTalk remains suspended; unfinished Pet Cat and Pet Rabbit choices remain disabled. See CHANGELOG.md for the full Chinese and English notes.
